hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/app.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/index.html|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/style.css|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tests/*) out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tests/run.sh 2>&1) || { echo "Tests failed:" >&2; echo "$out" | grep -v "^PASS" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
